payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
- When fetch first creates the state folder on Windows, only the current user shall have access to it.
- When the Windows CI consumer creates a state folder through fetch and reads its access list, no other principal shall be listed.

payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Context

The vault state contains private tracker data.
The current Windows path creates directories without enforcing private access.
Design v8 revision 4 requires private machine state.
POSIX already uses mode 0700.

## Scope

Enforce Windows state privacy through standard-library security APIs or the permitted process boundary.
Keep the tracker independent from the engine and third-party runtime packages.
Exercise the real fetch consumer on native Windows and in the existing Windows compatibility checks.
